labels.cold_pipe: Cold acquisition to NMRPipe, full 14 operations
labels.cold_ucsf: Cold acquisition to UCSF, full 14 operations
labels.export_pipe: Warm NMRPipe export of fixed accepted S10
labels.export_ucsf: Warm UCSF export of fixed accepted S10

method.cache: OS file cache uncontrolled; no purge, fsync, outlier exclusion or overhead subtraction
method.interactive: Fixed original first12 operations ending with indirect phase before final DI/TP; prime0degrees; changed warmup0.5degrees then manual1..7degrees; unchanged0degrees.128MiB retained-cache budget,1GiB total policy.
method.startup_scope: Cold fresh process includes startup through normal final output close plus CLI reporting. Warm API elapsed excludes worker imports, preload, harness result hash and pipe transport; normal product validation/provenance/output SHA remain included.

memory_scope: Cold RSS is fresh-process Linux wait4 ru_maxrss. Warm RSS is persistent-worker lifetime high-water sampled immediately after each API return, before that response signature; includes setup, prior operations and prior harness hashing, not seven independent operation peaks.
